# Assumption of Moses Chapter 9 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** Taxo and His Sons: Martyrdom as Witness

---

**1** Then a man from the tribe of Levi will appear, whose name is Taxo. He will have seven sons.

**2** He will speak to them and say: Look, my sons, a second cruel oppression has fallen on the people, more pitiless and more severe than the first.

**3** Come, listen to me, my sons, and understand what I am telling you.

**4** Our fathers and their fathers put God to the test three times and endured afflictions of the soul.

**5** But never before in the history of our people has anyone arisen who was as righteous and pure as our ancestors.

**6** Let us fast for three days, and on the fourth day let us go into a cave in the open country and die there rather than transgress the commandments of the Lord of lords, the God of our fathers.

**7** If we do this and die, our blood will be avenged before the Lord.

**8** For from our blood the Lord will take vengeance on the kings of the earth who have shed the blood of his holy ones.

**9** Then his kingdom will appear throughout all creation, and then Satan will be no more, and sorrow will be removed along with him.

**10** Then the hands of the heavenly messenger, who has been appointed as the highest from the very beginning, will be filled, and he will immediately avenge them against their enemies.
